name: deepseek-balance
description: DeepSeek credit in Claude Code: real balance with a gauge, today's spend, the model it mostly went to, and this key's own spend against a limit

apiKey.title: DeepSeek API key
apiKey.description: Key used to read the balance. Empty: DEEPSEEK_API_KEY, else the ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN / ANTHROPIC_API_KEY Claude Code sends when ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL points at DeepSeek

keyLimit.title: This key's spend limit
keyLimit.description: Spend limit for this key in the balance currency (0 = none). DeepSeek has no per-key limits, so the mod tracks it

gaugeFull.title: Gauge full at
gaugeFull.description: Balance that fills the gauge (0 = the balance right after your last top-up)

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Which balance to show when the account holds both

contextWindow.title: Context window (tokens)
contextWindow.description: Window the context gauge measures against (0 = what Claude Code reports for the model; DeepSeek V3.2 is 128000)

refreshSeconds.title: Refresh every (seconds)
refreshSeconds.description: How often the balance is read (at least 30)
